method: Searches (17): site:websummit.com appearances lis26 Brazil (shared with brazil-2); "websummit.com/appearances/lis26" Brasil startup (shared); site:websummit.com lis26 ... Rio/Florianópolis/Recife (shared); startup selecionada "Web Summit Lisboa 2026"; "Web Summit Lisboa" 2026 startup brasileira participará novembro; "Web Summit 2026" Lisboa empresa brasileira vai participar/estará presente; ACATE startups catarinenses; Porto Digital startups pernambucanas; Instituto Caldeira OR SENAI CIMATEC; five company names from brazil-2; "nossa startup"/"foi selecionada"; segs.com.br; startup "no Web Summit Lisboa" 2026 IA; Paraíba 30 startups; state delegations (Ceará, Piauí, Goiás, Amazonas, Pará, Espírito Santo, Acre); startup mineira/gaúcha/paulista/baiana; Wood Lab Acre; "selecionada para o Web Summit" 2026; Pavilhão Brasil healthtech/agtech/fintech. Pages opened (19): DN Brasil 2024 list and RCO 2022 (both earlier editions, not used); ABCD da Comunicação tag page (only 2021 to 2025 items, not used); Startups.com.br tag web-summit-lisboa-2026 (Rio ten, already known); A União (503); DuckDuckGo and Bing (bot check, useless results); Portal Pop Notícias (Ilha Tech); FAPESQ (503); Paraíba Total 3 Nov (no names); Portal do Litoral PB (403); Polêmica Paraíba 5 Nov (the 30 names); BRA 1 19 Oct (no names yet); Business Moment (SP ten); Agência Sebrae 16 Oct (Wood Lab); ApexBrasil news (login redirect); Exame Bússola (Plantah); Maravalley (Rio ten); Brasil 247 3 Nov (no names). Distinct sources looked at (opened or read as search results): 30 or more, including also WSCOM, Turismo em Foco, Jampa News, BigPB, Rota Bioceânica, Brasil Inovador, Reconecta News, Anprotec, DN Brasil (200 empresas), Portugal Global, O Tempo, Starten, ACATE and Acontecendo Aqui. Total fetches 36 of 40 (17 searches, 19 pages). Each item is one company in one source. on_lis26_listing gives the matching name in brazil-2.json (the Web Summit listing), 'probable' where the names differ in form, null where no match was found. Left to do: company blogs and LinkedIn posts (LinkedIn needs a login, not used); the other 11 state missions Sebrae counts (only Paraíba, São Paulo and Rio found by name); the 100 national selection and the hub nominations (no public names found); Startups.com.br, StartSe, Baguete and Segs not searched page by page.

302 redirect to an ApexBrasil login page; not followed
